entities.summary: Chris Driedger is a Canadian professional ice hockey goaltender who is an unrestricted free agent. He most recently played for Traktor Chelyabinsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Driedger was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the third round, 76th overall, of the 2012 NHL entry draft.
